role: source acquisition and byte verification only; no flower-colour values may be opened or joined in this workflow

inferential_boundary.role: postoutcome expanded environmental process panel only
inferential_boundary.reason: use a computationally tractable broad-scale SoilGrids aggregate while keeping the original unavailable 250-m median confirmatory family unreclassified

depth_aggregation: for each property, thickness-weighted arithmetic mean = (5*x_0_5 + 10*x_5_15 + 15*x_15_30) / 30 at each raster cell, requiring all three layers finite
official_checksum_rule: for each property also freeze and save {base_url}/{property}/checksum.sha256.txt and require each selected GeoTIFF SHA256 to match the official manifest

downstream.standardization: global terrestrial z-score per derived 0-30cm property on cells with finite derived value
downstream.block_edge_score: sqrt(mean squared endpoint difference across four standardized derived properties)
